hero.title: Cute memories from <accent>Vietnam</accent>.
hero.subtitle: Playful Vietnam-inspired souvenirs designed through BISCUTE's own characters, artwork, and graphic language — easy to pack and bring home.

brandIntro.title: What is BISCUTE?
brandIntro.paragraph1: BISCUTE is a playful contemporary Vietnamese souvenir brand in Hanoi's Old Quarter. Vietnam-inspired subjects come through BISCUTE's own characters, artwork, and graphic language — not generic tourism decoration.
brandIntro.paragraph2: This site is a product catalogue for discovery, not online shopping. Browse what we make, then visit BISCUTE Vietnam to find it in person.

visualLanguage.title: BISCUTE Visual Language
visualLanguage.body: Vietnamese culture interpreted through playful characters and artwork that feel unmistakably BISCUTE — cute, contemporary, and designed to be remembered.

travelFriendly.title: Made to Travel
travelFriendly.body: Souvenirs and gifts chosen with packing in mind — lightweight, easy to carry, and ready to bring home from your trip.

cultureReimagined.title: Local Culture
cultureReimagined.body: Places, food, and everyday culture become inspiration for products — seen through BISCUTE's perspective rather than traditional souvenir clichés.
